final: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as member_count FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL GROUP BY link_to_major), totals AS (SELECT SUM(member_count) as total_members, AVG(member_count) as avg_group_count FROM major_counts) SELECT mc.link_to_major, m.major_name, mc.member_count, mc.member_count * 1.0 / t.total_members as share_of_total, mc.member_count * 1.0 / t.avg_group_count as ratio_to_average FROM major_counts mc JOIN major m ON mc.link_to_major = m.major_id, totals t ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC LIMIT 10
